member.name: T:Gordic.Tools.SecurityTest.Controls.CscSettingsControl
member.summary: Represents a user control for configuring settings related to the CSC (Cloud signature consortium API) system.
member.remarks: This control provides functionality to load, save, and initialize configuration data for the CSC system. It includes fields for specifying the working directory, system login credentials, timeout settings, and other related parameters. The control interacts with a object to persist and retrieve configuration values.
